editorNote: A rebound Monday across the watchlist after last week's slide: Rocket Lab, gold, bitcoin, Alibaba and Alphabet all moved up in the headlines. Google News pages could not be opened, so these items rest on headlines alone.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab rallies 11% after its worst week ever as its CFO points to higher Electron prices; AST SpaceMobile jumps 14%
stories.summary: Headlines from Monday say Rocket Lab shares rose about 11% after the stock's worst week on record, and that the CFO sees 'very strong' Electron demand ahead and room for higher Electron prices.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a rebound after a steep slide the paper has tracked for days; details beyond the headlines were not independently verified.

stories.headline: Gold bounces on Nov. 23, rising 2.43% and reclaiming $3,600 after a steep weekly drop
stories.summary: USA Today lists gold up 2.43% on Nov. 23, Kitco has it above $3,600 as the AI selloff reshapes the Fed outlook, and Mining.com says bargain hunters stepped in after the steep weekly decline.
stories.whyItMatters: It follows StoneX's note that gold had its worst week since March; this reports a move, not a forecast.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Price Today: Gold Rises 2.43% on November 23, 2026 - USA Today

stories.headline: Bitcoin rebounds past $63,000 and crypto stocks rally, while Bloomberg flags a gathering ETF exodus
stories.summary: Barron's reports Strategy and crypto stocks rallying as bitcoin climbs past $63,000; CoinDesk says bitcoin is lagging a Nvidia-led AI rebound; Bloomberg's headline describes accelerating bitcoin ETF outflows removing a key source of support.
stories.whyItMatters: The bounce is small against the recent two-year low, and ETF outflows are the countervailing flow in the headlines.

sourceLinks.title: Strategy and Crypto Stocks Rally as Bitcoin Rebounds Past $63,000. Is the Jump Temporary? - Barron's

stories.headline: Investing.com asks why Alibaba's ADR is surging on Monday
stories.summary: The headline reports a surge in Alibaba's U.S.-listed shares on Nov. 23; the cause was not verified beyond the headline.
stories.whyItMatters: It follows a stretch of target cuts and a class action in the days before.

sourceLinks.title: Why is Alibaba ADR stock surging today? - Investing.com

stories.headline: Alphabet stock trades higher on Monday, TradingView and Investing.com report
stories.summary: Both outlets carry headlines saying Alphabet shares were trading up on Nov. 23; the drivers were not verified beyond the headlines.
stories.whyItMatters: It comes after Alphabet closed down 3.46% on Anthropic's debut day (Nov. 19).
